_: privacy.html / terms.html are built from these (build.py): operator = the person responsible (개인정보 보호책임자), email = a public contact address (leave empty to point to the in-game 문의하기 only), db_region = the Supabase project's region (Project Settings → General), effective = the date the current text takes effect (also sent with an e-mail sign-up as terms)
